cat /tmp/hist.txt
awk -F'"' '{split($3,v," "); if($2=="+Inf"){t=v[2]} else {L[n]=$2; V[n++]=v[2]}} END{for(i=0;i<n;i++) if(V[i]>=t*0.95){print L[i]; exit}}' /tmp/hist.txt > /tmp/p95.txt
cat /tmp/p95.txt
